Over millions of years, this folding and faulting, combined with erosion and deposition processes, leads to the uplift and formation of mountain ranges. Additionally, the pressure and heat generated during these collisions can cause metamorphism, transforming existing rocks into new forms, further contributing to the complex geology of mountain regions. Over millions of years, this folding and faulting, combined with erosion and deposition processes, leads to the uplift and formation of mountain ranges. Additionally, the pressure and heat generated during these collisions can cause metamorphism, transforming existing rocks into new forms, further contributing to the complex geology of mountain regions. This silencing occurs through two main mechanisms: mRNA degradation and translational repression. When miRNAs pair with their target mRNA with perfect or near-perfect complementarity, the mRNA is usually cleaved and degraded. When the pairing is imperfect, translation of the mRNA is typically repressed. Additionally, miRNAs are involved in various cellular processes such as development, differentiation, apoptosis, and metabolism. Dysregulation of miRNA expression has been linked to numerous diseases, including cancer.

When miRNAs pair with their target mRNA with perfect or near-perfect complementarity, the mRNA is usually cleaved and degraded. When the pairing is imperfect, translation of the mRNA is typically repressed. Additionally, miRNAs are involved in various cellular processes such as development, differentiation, apoptosis, and metabolism.
